FABLE CHECKPOINT — CHECKOUT PAGE CONNECTED + COMPOSITION READY @ 7dbcd1500877e9288bd23087f79f0a323ca367df on claude/durable-payment-port-20260909 (chain now 30e8b7a, 8baaead, 4a7463e, d0d6096, c70b77e, 5c52abb, 7d180f8 composition/cancel/recovery/config, 70ab791 checkout page, 7dbcd15 patch proposal). All pushed.
MOUNTED IN PRODUCTION: nothing new. The canonical page /research/member/checkout now asks GET /api/research/checkout/payment-config once; while it answers 503 payment_disabled (or is unpublished) the page uses the ordering door byte-for-byte as before (30 legacy tests unchanged). With a published config it collects the card in the provider-hosted element (pm_ only), freezes ONE request per logical submission (same key + body on retry; a lost answer keeps it frozen; a definitive denial reopens the form on the same key; the key rotates only on completed/cancelled/explicit new request), mounts the continuation step for authentication_required/pending/processing/reconciliation_required (bank flow, check status = one bounded server reconciliation, cancel door), shows completed only from the server (order ref + link, "payment received is not shipment"), resumes after refresh via request key in sessionStorage bound to the account's cart scope + owner-checked lookup (no secrets stored), fences every answer to the requesting token.
SERVER @ 7d180f8: durable-checkout-composition.ts = ONE builder (store+port+coordinator+submission+continuation+webhook processor) with fail-closed readiness (Disabled provider or non-durable store outside NODE_ENV=test => every door mounts as 503 refusal; config answers payment_disabled); GET payment-config (publishable key + mode; refuses live/test mismatch; never a secret); POST .../executions/:key/cancel (crash-resumable; cancel with lost reference LEARNS the payment inside retention before cancelling; never declares cancelled while uncertain; captured => commits instead); executor.recover = one read-only reconciliation for a parked execution (identical retry + "check payment status"; outside retention stays parked); webhook handler lets the durable inbox process execution-owned events without the legacy atomic store (unbound events still fail closed); in-memory store mirrors the SQL commit effects incl. failed-local-commit => reconciliation_required with capture evidence kept.
A — YOUR PATHS: production-deps.ts and server/index.ts are in your active lease, so the mount is an EXACT PATCH PROPOSAL, not applied: docs/research-commerce/DURABLE_CHECKOUT_COMPOSITION_PATCH_20260909.md (imports, state 1/2 unavailableDurableCheckout, state 3 composeDurableCheckout threaded into createWebhookHandler as executions, index.ts registerDurableCheckoutSurface after registerCommerceApi, wiring tests to add, env: NEW STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY). Task DURABLE-CHECKOUT-COMPOSITION-MOUNT-20260909 is ready for you to claim. Rehearsal of the SQL candidate (unchanged since c70b77e) is still yours; an executable rehearsal script with synthetic fixtures + RPC assertions follows from me in the next commit.
